content.json:
# Asset-Terminator — Wipe Requests
Audit e monitoraggio end-to-end delle richieste di dismissione. I dati provengono dagli audit `customEvents` emessi da API, worker e runbook (nome evento = `auditAction`, dimensioni: `requestId`, `platform`, `scenario`, `status`, `serialNumber`).

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.label: Piattaforma
parameters.query: customEvents | where name startswith 'Wipe' or name startswith 'Runbook' | extend platform = tostring(customDimensions.platform) | where isnotempty(platform) | distinct platform | order by platform asc

content.json:
## Funnel della pipeline
Richieste uniche (`requestId`) che hanno raggiunto ciascuna fase.

content.query: let stages = datatable(stage:string, ord:long)['1. Received',1,'2. Queued',2,'3. Dispatched',3,'4. Pending device',4,'5. Terminal',5]; customEvents | where name in ('WipeRequestReceived','WipeRequestQueued','WipeJobStarted','WipeDryRunCompleted','WipePendingDeviceAction','WipeTerminalState') | extend requestId = tostring(customDimensions.requestId), platform = tostring(customDimensions.platform) | where isnotempty(requestId) | where '*' in (Platform) or platform in (Platform) | extend stage = case(name == 'WipeRequestReceived','1. Received', name == 'WipeRequestQueued','2. Queued', name in ('WipeJobStarted','WipeDryRunCompleted'),'3. Dispatched', name == 'WipePendingDeviceAction','4. Pending device', name == 'WipeTerminalState','5. Terminal','other') | summarize Requests = dcount(requestId) by stage | join kind=rightouter stages on stage | project ord, stage, Requests = coalesce(Requests, 0) | order by ord asc
content.title: Funnel (richieste uniche per fase)

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'WipeRequestReceived' | extend platform = tostring(customDimensions.platform) | where '*' in (Platform) or platform in (Platform) | summarize Requests = count() by bin(timestamp, 30m) | render timechart
content.title: Richieste ricevute nel tempo

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'WipeTerminalState' | extend status = tostring(customDimensions.status), platform = tostring(customDimensions.platform) | where '*' in (Platform) or platform in (Platform) | summarize Count = count() by status | render piechart
content.title: Esiti terminali

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'WipeRequestReceived' | extend platform = tostring(customDimensions.platform) | where '*' in (Platform) or platform in (Platform) | summarize Count = count() by platform | render piechart
content.title: Richieste per piattaforma

content.query: customEvents | where name == 'WipeRequestReceived' | extend scenario = tostring(customDimensions.scenario), platform = tostring(customDimensions.platform) | where '*' in (Platform) or platform in (Platform) | summarize Count = count() by scenario | render piechart
content.title: Richieste per scenario

content.json:
## Richieste recenti
Ultimo stato noto per ciascun `requestId`.

content.query: customEvents | where name startswith 'Wipe' | extend requestId = tostring(customDimensions.requestId), platform = tostring(customDimensions.platform), scenario = tostring(customDimensions.scenario), status = tostring(customDimensions.status), serialNumber = tostring(customDimensions.serialNumber) | where isnotempty(requestId) | where '*' in (Platform) or platform in (Platform) | summarize arg_max(timestamp, name, status, platform, scenario, serialNumber) by requestId | project LastSeen = timestamp, requestId, platform, scenario, serialNumber, lastAction = name, status | order by LastSeen desc | take 200
content.title: Richieste recenti (ultimo stato per requestId)

content.json:
## Errori, rifiuti e wipe falliti
Eventi che richiedono attenzione operativa.

content.query: customEvents | where name in ('WipeRequestRejected','WipeDispatchFailed','WipeTimeout','WipeCallbackFailed','WipeDeviceActionCheckFailed','DeviceWipeFailed','GraphConnectFailed') or (name == 'WipeTerminalState' and tostring(customDimensions.status) in ('Failed','PartiallyCompleted')) | extend requestId = tostring(customDimensions.requestId), platform = tostring(customDimensions.platform), status = tostring(customDimensions.status), reason = tostring(customDimensions.reason), error = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.error), tostring(customDimensions.errorMessage)), serialNumber = tostring(customDimensions.serialNumber) | where '*' in (Platform) or platform in (Platform) | project timestamp, requestId, platform, action = name, status, reason, error, serialNumber, role = cloud_RoleName | order by timestamp desc | take 200
content.title: Errori e rifiuti

content.json:
## Attività dei runbook
Eventi emessi dai runbook di piattaforma (`cloud_RoleName` inizia con `RBK-`).

content.query: customEvents | where cloud_RoleName startswith 'RBK-' | extend requestId = tostring(customDimensions.requestId), platform = tostring(customDimensions.platform), serialNumber = tostring(customDimensions.serialNumber), dryRun = tostring(customDimensions.dryRun) | where '*' in (Platform) or platform in (Platform) | project timestamp, runbook = cloud_RoleName, action = name, requestId, serialNumber, dryRun | order by timestamp desc | take 200
content.title: Eventi runbook
